# Bid the joints, the access, and the extras.

> Price tuckpointing from wall area, grind versus smear, scaffold versus swing stage, and extras — plus the walk-away price an $8 / sq ft special cannot see.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
